name: Shion
source:
"It can’t be helped. Being ‘special’ isn’t always a good thing."

A boy with platinum-colored hair and pale blue-purple eyes, giving a fragile impression. Calm and gentle, he expresses emotions sparingly. However, he is actually very capable and possesses a strong will. Since Subaru took him in, he has served as a gardener.

[Translated from [url=https://www.primula.jpn.com/qualiadelta/chara01.html]the official website[/url].]
